name: LaguQA-Gemma4-E2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-E2B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-E2B-it: 7 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim 256) and 28 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of google/gemma-4-E2B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 5.104 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-02.
